correctness.rationale: Exact integral Hessian identity; all four mod-3 singular-locus Groebner quotients have length nine and nine distinct rational points, yielding exactly 15 ordinary double points. Exhaustive evaluation over P3(F3) and P3(F9) yields 25 and 145 points; resolving nodes gives 70 and 280, saturating the K3 F9 Weil upper bound and fixing normalized Frobenius multiplicities +21/-1. All 130 rational Grassmannian lines are enumerated with polynomial coefficient vanishing; 20 lie on the quartic. The nodal/line incidence gives an exact 35x35 intersection Gram, with a nonzero 21x21 principal minor determinant 1536. The arithmetic Frobenius fixed H2 space has dimension exactly 21, therefore these 35 rational curves span all invariant Neron-Severi classes over Q. Packaged verify.py and execution output independently establish all finite inputs; infinity follows from K3 cohomological bounds.

originality.rationale: Prior matched arithmetic records on this same surface determine 15 nodes and the entire zeta function, but not an explicit rank-21 rational divisor spanning set. Dolgachev (2003) documents the classical 20 Steiner lines and their nodal incidence; Dolgachev (2019) calculates moduli-general complex Picard rank 16 rather than the F3 arithmetic rank 21. The additional exact characteristic-three 35-curve Gram minor is a genuinely new needed implication, not a renaming of the zeta function or generic incidence. published-finding corpus and primary searches found no equivalent complete statement, subject to noted historical risks.
residual_risks: An unindexed or inaccessible positive-characteristic Picard computation might already tabulate this 35-curve rank.
Classical twenty-line and (15_4,20_3) incidence is known, and the characteristic-three zeta is already known; novelty is confined to the explicit complete rational arithmetic Picard generation.

value.rationale: A complete explicit rational generating set for the arithmetic Picard group of a distinguished supersingular K3 is intrinsically motivated, not a mere point-count repetition. The construction bridges the classical nodal-line configuration and the 21-dimensional arithmetic cycle space, exposing precisely one geometric divisor direction that fails to descend to F3. It gives concrete line/exceptional classes for future intersection and arithmetic investigations; no downstream theorem is required for that natural complete invariant.
